1: package llmverify
2: 
3: import chisel3._
4: import chisel3.util._
5: import chiselFv._
6: 
7: class b03 extends Module with Formal {
8:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
9:     val REQUEST1 = Input(Bool())
10:     val REQUEST2 = Input(Bool())
11:     val REQUEST3 = Input(Bool())
12:     val REQUEST4 = Input(Bool())
13:     val GRANT_O = Output(UInt(4.W))
14:   })
15: 
16:   // Constants
17:   val U1 = "b100".U(3.W)
18:   val U2 = "b010".U(3.W)
19:   val U3 = "b001".U(3.W)
20:   val U4 = "b111".U(3.W)
21: 
22:   // State enumeration
23:   val sInit :: sAnalisReq :: sAssegna :: Nil = Enum(3)
24:   val stato = RegInit(sInit)
25: 
26:   // Queue registers
27:   val coda0 = RegInit(0.U(3.W))
28:   val coda1 = RegInit(0.U(3.W))
29:   val coda2 = RegInit(0.U(3.W))
30:   val coda3 = RegInit(0.U(3.W))
31: 
32:   // Request registers
33:   val ru1 = RegInit(false.B)
34:   val ru2 = RegInit(false.B)
35:   val ru3 = RegInit(false.B)
36:   val ru4 = RegInit(false.B)
37: 
38:   // Follow-up registers
39:   val fu1 = RegInit(false.B)
40:   val fu2 = RegInit(false.B)
41:   val fu3 = RegInit(false.B)
42:   val fu4 = RegInit(false.B)
43: 
44:   // Grant register
45:   val grant = RegInit(0.U(4.W))
46: 
47:   // Output register
48:   io.GRANT_O := grant
49: 
50:   // State machine
51:   switch(stato) {
52:     is(sInit) {
53:       ru1 := io.REQUEST1
54:       ru2 := io.REQUEST2
55:       ru3 := io.REQUEST3
56:       ru4 := io.REQUEST4
57:       stato := sAnalisReq
58:     }
59:     
60:     is(sAnalisReq) {
61:       // Queue update logic
62:       when(ru1 && !fu1) {
63:         coda3 := coda2
64:         coda2 := coda1
65:         coda1 := coda0
66:         coda0 := U1
67:       }.elsewhen(ru2 && !fu2) {
68:         coda3 := coda2
69:         coda2 := coda1
70:         coda1 := coda0
71:         coda0 := U2
72:       }.elsewhen(ru3 && !fu3) {
73:         coda3 := coda2
74:         coda2 := coda1
75:         coda1 := coda0
76:         coda0 := U3
77:       }.elsewhen(ru4 && !fu4) {
78:         coda3 := coda2
79:         coda2 := coda1
80:         coda1 := coda0
81:         coda0 := U4
82:       }
83: 
84:       // Update follow-up registers
85:       fu1 := ru1
86:       fu2 := ru2
87:       fu3 := ru3
88:       fu4 := ru4
89: 
90:       stato := sAssegna
91:     }
92:     
93:     is(sAssegna) {
94:       when(fu1 || fu2 || fu3 || fu4) {
95:         // Grant assignment based on queue head
96:         switch(coda0) {
97:           is(U1) { grant := "b1000".U }
98:           is(U2) { grant := "b0100".U }
99:           is(U3) { grant := "b0010".U }
100:           is(U4) { grant := "b0001".U }
101:         }
102:         
103:         // Default case for grant assignment
104:         when(!(coda0 === U1 || coda0 === U2 || coda0 === U3 || coda0 === U4)) {
105:           grant := "b0000".U
106:         }
107:         
108:         // Shift queue
109:         coda0 := coda1
110:         coda1 := coda2
111:         coda2 := coda3
112:         coda3 := 0.U
113:       }
114:       
115:       // Capture new requests
116:       ru1 := io.REQUEST1
117:       ru2 := io.REQUEST2
118:       ru3 := io.REQUEST3
119:       ru4 := io.REQUEST4
120:       
121:       stato := sAnalisReq
122:     }
123:   }
124: 
125:   // ===== FORMAL VERIFICATION ASSERTIONS =====
126: 
127:   // Safety: Grant output is one-hot (at most one bit set)
128:   assertOneHot(io.GRANT_O, "GRANT_O_one_hot")
129: 
130:   // Safety: Grant output only uses valid encodings
131:   fvAssert(
132:     io.GRANT_O === "b0000".U || io.GRANT_O === "b1000".U ||
133:     io.GRANT_O === "b0100".U || io.GRANT_O === "b0010".U || io.GRANT_O === "b0001".U,
134:     "GRANT_O_valid_encoding"
135:   )
136: 
137:   // Safety: State machine stays in one of the three valid states
138:   fvAssert(
139:     stato === sInit || stato === sAnalisReq || stato === sAssegna,
140:     "valid_state"
141:   )
142: 
143:   // Safety: All queue entries contain only valid request IDs or zero (empty)
144:   fvAssert(
145:     coda0 === 0.U || coda0 === U1 || coda0 === U2 || coda0 === U3 || coda0 === U4,
146:     "coda0_valid"
147:   )
148:   fvAssert(
149:     coda1 === 0.U || coda1 === U1 || coda1 === U2 || coda1 === U3 || coda1 === U4,
150:     "coda1_valid"
151:   )
152:   fvAssert(
153:     coda2 === 0.U || coda2 === U1 || coda2 === U2 || coda2 === U3 || coda2 === U4,
154:     "coda2_valid"
155:   )
156:   fvAssert(
157:     coda3 === 0.U || coda3 === U1 || coda3 === U2 || coda3 === U3 || coda3 === U4,
158:     "coda3_valid"
159:   )
160: 
161:   // Safety: When granting in sAssegna with pending follow-ups and non-zero grant,
162:   // the grant value must match the request ID stored in the queue head (coda0)
163:   fvAssert(
164:     !(stato === sAssegna && (fu1 || fu2 || fu3 || fu4) && grant =/= "b0000".U) ||
165:     (grant === "b1000".U && coda0 === U1) ||
166:     (grant === "b0100".U && coda0 === U2) ||
167:     (grant === "b0010".U && coda0 === U3) ||
168:     (grant === "b0001".U && coda0 === U4),
169:     "grant_matches_queue_head"
170:   )
171: 
172:   // Bounded liveness: When the queue head contains a valid request ID,
173:   // the grant output becomes non-zero within 6 cycles.
174:   // Queue depth is 4, state machine processes one entry per 2-cycle pipeline,
175:   // so worst-case latency is < 10 cycles; bound of 6 is safe for head-of-line.
176:   val coda0ValidID = coda0 === U1 || coda0 === U2 || coda0 === U3 || coda0 === U4
177:   astRelaxedLiveness(coda0ValidID, grant =/= 0.U, 6, "queue_head_eventually_granted")
178: }
